title: STLTH Loop 9K Pod Pack – Juicy Peach Ice
description:
Description
Warranty
Dive into a frosty paradise with juicy peach ice, where the succulent sweetness of ripe peaches meets a refreshing icy chill. Experience the perfect blend of fruity indulgence and cool exhilaration in every puff.
*All STLTH Loop 2 Pods require a
STLTH Loop 2 Device
to function.
Experience the future of vaping with the STLTH Loop 2 Closed Pod System. This innovative system features the rechargeable STLTH Loop 2 Closed Pod Device and replaceable prefilled STLTH Loop 9K Pods, offering the convenience of disposable vapes with sustainability and cost-effectiveness. Boasting a generous 17ml e-liquid capacity and vertical mesh coil technology, STLTH Loop 9K pods deliver a flavour-rich experience for up to 9000 smooth puffs, ensuring long-lasting satisfaction.
Compatible with the STLTH Loop Device and STLTH Loop 2 Device, the Loop 9K pods introduce an innovative e-liquid level reading technology when paired exclusively with the STLTH Loop 2. The intuitive E-liquid Indicator Feature on the Loop 2 Device communicates with the STLTH Loop 9K Pod to display real-time e-liquid levels, eliminating the guesswork for pod replacement.
When it’s time to replace your pod, the process is effortless. STLTH Loop and VICE Loop Pods snap into place with magnetic attachment, ensuring a secure connection to the Device. With 30 vibrant flavours to choose from, including popular flavours from STLTH 8K PRO Disposables, the STLTH Loop 9K Pods offer a flavour experience that is as diverse as it is satisfying. Vape forward with STLTH Loop 9K Pods!
Up to 9000 puffs.
Vertical mesh coil.
Direct draw firing mechanism.
Contains 17ml e-liquid.
Please recycle when empty at a proper recycling depot.
Warranty
30 DAYS. NO HASSLES. GUARANTEED. YES, YOU READ THAT RIGHT.
We doubt you’ll have any problems with your purchases; however, we understand mistakes and oversights can happen. Sometimes it’s a manufacturing defect, poor battery life, or you just don’t like what you’ve paid for. No problem. For a period of 30 days from your purchase you can exchange your Device for a new one or receive a FULL in-store or online credit. Physical damages to products void all warranties, express or implied.
Device & DISPOSABLE WARRANTY CONDITIONS
To have a valid warranty claim on a Device or disposable vape Device, you must keep the product packaging/outer sleeve which contains the proof of purchase and authentication stickers. We cannot warranty Devices or disposable vape Devices without their original packaging.
